title: Cylindrical body
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at coordinates (0.0237, 0.0237) with a radius of 0.0237. Draw the second loop as another circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.0184. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0473 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same vector to position it correctly. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a cylindrical solid body. Ensure that this operation does not extrude in the opposite direction and that it results in a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical body are 0.04730318897637796 units in length, 0.04730318897637796 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0237, 0.0237)  # Move to the center of the circles
    .circle(0.0237)  # Outer circle
    .circle(0.0184)  # Inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75, both=False)  # Extrude only in the positive direction

# The final model
r = extrusion

length = 0.75

    cq.Workplane("XY")

    .circle(inner_diameter / 2.0)
